scope.summary: Implement twist/roll bone generation as a per-export-profile option and root-motion conventions per engine per Section 13.18 (BK-18.4, TAI-BK-071), closing GREQ-037/038: the authority skeleton always carries its twist bones (deletion prohibited per TAI-BK-074); export profiles may strip, keep, or remap them, and each engine profile declares its root-motion convention (in-place vs root-driven, root bone naming) — canonical profile law lives in 13.26, this MT ships the skeleton-side machinery.
acceptance_criteria: TwistBoneOption per export profile: Keep (pass through authority twist bones), Strip (remove twist bones and re-bake their weights onto parent bones, renormalized), Remap (rename to a target convention via a declared name map); all three produce valid normalized skinning.

Strip mode proof: a stripped skeleton has zero *_twist_* bones, weights renormalize to 1.0 per vertex, and the 90-degree forearm-twist fixture deforms acceptably degraded-but-valid (quantified against the Keep baseline).
Deleting twist bones from the AUTHORITY skeleton is impossible: the skeleton-def mutation API rejects removal of twist bones with a typed prohibition error (TAI-BK-074).

RootMotionConvention {mode: InPlace | RootDriven, root_bone_name} is a typed per-profile declaration; applying a convention to a clip produces the expected root track transformation (in-place zeroes root translation into a motion track; root-driven preserves it) on a walking-clip fixture.
Profile options persist on bodykit_export_profiles rows (BXP-) and are consumed by the 13.26 export lane via a typed accessor.
scope.risk_if_missed: Twist bones are what keep long slender limbs from candy-wrapping at extreme leg_length/arm_girth values; profiles that silently drop them without weight re-bake ship broken game rigs, and undeclared root-motion conventions are the classic source of sliding-feet imports in UE.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
